description: Configure how staff promotions are handled and announced.

content.name: enablePromotions
content.description: If disabled, the /staff-management promote command will not work.

content.name: autoAddRole
content.description: If enabled, the bot will automatically give the user the new rank role. Note: This makes your server prone to raids by promoting someone to a role with more dangerous permissions which can be used to do malicious actions. It is recommended to keep this setting disabled.

content.name: promotionsChannel
content.description: The channel where promotion announcements will be sent.

content.name: promotionMessage
content.description: This will be the message sent when someone is promoted.

params.name: new-role-name
params.description: The plain text name of the new role.

params.name: new-role-mention
params.description: The pingable mention of the new role.

params.name: promoter-mention
params.description: Pings the staff member who issued the promotion.

params.name: promoter-name
params.description: The username of the staff member who issued the promotion.

params.name: user-avatar
params.description: The avatar URL of the promoted user.

params.name: promoter-avatar
params.description: The avatar URL of the promoter.

embeds.title: 🎉 New promotion!
embeds.description:
Congratulations, you have been promoted to **%new-role-name%**!

**Promoted to:** %new-role-mention%
**On behalf of:** %promoter-mention%
**Reason:** %reason%

content.name: dmPromotedUser
content.description: If enabled, the user will receive a direct message when promoted.

content.name: promotionDmMessage
content.description: The message sent directly to the user.
